abilities.name: Witchglass Choir
abilities.text: Once per round, after you pass a Signal test, record 1 Route Note.

abilities.name: Route Burn
abilities.text: After you clear a blue or movement sector, leave 1 Route Note on that sector for any operative.

abilities.name: Hush Static
abilities.text: Once per round, the first blue Anomaly you face has -1 difficulty.

abilities.name: Choir Lash
abilities.text: Once per round, when scenario pressure rises on your turn, record 1 Route Note. Weakness: Route Notes cannot be used on Grit battles.
